text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًۭا

baseline.text: Hani Musa genç yardımcısına, İki denizin birleştiği yere ulaşıncaya kadar durmayacağım ya da uzun zaman yürümeyi sürdüreceğim, demişti.

findings.text: Musa'nın açık uçlu zaman kararlılığı, iki denizin birleştiği mekansal işarete ulaşmaya bağlanır; sonuca salt istekle değil, yolu sürdürerek varılır.
Çağlar boyu ilerleme isteği hedefi bulmaya yetmez; süre, geride taşınıp unutulmuş maddi işarete göre düzeltilmelidir.

activation_trace.role: Under negation, the branch turns leaving or ceasing into continued persistence and supplies the vow's engine.
Attainment of a limit supplies the event that can terminate the persistence.
Gathering separated elements makes convergence, rather than mere distance, the sought endpoint.
Passing onward supplies the alternative course if convergence remains unattained.
Extended duration removes an ordinary temporal cap from the commitment.

changed_reading.after: Moses self-binds movement to purpose: only attained convergence, not fatigue or elapsed time, can close the journey.
changed_reading.before: A traveler states a destination and a willingness to travel far.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "I will not cease ... until I reach ... or proceed for ages" binds motion to an endpoint rather than to a normal travel limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated cessation keeps the journey active until a convergence is attained; if it is not attained, onward passage expands into a long duration. Purpose, not elapsed time, is made the stopping condition.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the joining of what had been separate and makes relation the site's defining action.
Vast water gives each member of the dual its own expansive field.
The wide-cleft image preserves a boundary or opening inside the scene of contact.

changed_reading.after: The goal is a functioning interface: distinct expanses are brought into relation while their duality remains live.
changed_reading.before: The goal is a point at which two seas simply merge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "The meeting-place of the two seas" combines a gathering noun with a dual whose two members remain grammatically distinct.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathering relates separated expanses without requiring their identities to disappear. The destination is therefore readable as an interface whose function is to hold difference in contact, not merely as one undifferentiated body of water.

activation_trace.role: Forward passage supplies the baseline vector that the context will reverse.
The endpoint is objectively attained before it becomes recognized as the endpoint.
Loss from active memory interrupts recognition at the very site of arrival.
Crossing and passing the place converts attained arrival into overshoot.
Explicit seeking retrospectively identifies the missed site as the desired one.
Return reverses the journey's direction and becomes necessary to complete arrival.
Remaining marks make the already-traversed route newly legible.
Following a trace turns backward movement into a precise recovery procedure.

changed_reading.after: The confluence can be reached before it is known; completed arrival requires reading a loss, reversing course, and recovering the path retrospectively.
changed_reading.before: To reach the confluence is to advance until one consciously arrives there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travelers reach the named site, fail to register it, pass beyond it, then identify what they sought and return by following their traces. Reaching is revised from a monotonic forward event into retrospective recognition enacted by reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, forgetting, overshoot, recognition, and traced return; I infer that the lapse mediates recognition rather than merely delaying it. A live alternative is a simpler travel mishap with no general claim about how destinations become known.
structural_cues: 18:61 repeats the focus roots for reaching and convergence before the forgetting clause.
18:62 places passing-beyond after objective arrival; 18:64 answers it with return along prior marks.

activation_trace.role: The gathering-place branch keeps the activation attached to the specifically sought site.
The unplanned-encounter branch makes room for a destination disclosed through an unintended event.
The concrete fish is the carried object whose function changes from food to sign.
An extended traversable way turns the fish's departure into directional information.
The descending passage or channel gives the sign a path into a normally opaque medium.
Recovery after forgetting converts the earlier event into usable guidance.
Marked unfamiliarity distinguishes the route-event from ordinary loss of provisions.

changed_reading.after: The destination announces itself when the provision exits their possession and makes its own path; apparent loss becomes navigational disclosure.
changed_reading.before: Moses and his attendant carry provisions while seeking a fixed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carried fish leaves the provisioning economy and acquires a route into the sea; its delayed recollection then identifies the sought location. An item meant to sustain the journey becomes the sign that redirects it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fish, food, sea-path, wonder, and immediate target recognition; I infer that the fish's departure functions as a waymark. Alternatively, it may be only a singular sign with no broader conversion of provision into guidance.
structural_cues: The fish is lost at the convergence in 18:61, requested as morning food in 18:62, reported in 18:63, and recognized as the target-sign in 18:64.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated elements supplies the focus anchor for a later joining of seeker and teacher.
Finding replaces geographic search with encounter as the next attained object.
Merciful tenderness characterizes the encountered source rather than the landscape.
Disclosure to a knower makes hidden understanding the encounter's operative resource.
Following behind establishes the social direction through which learning can proceed.
Right orientation turns apprenticeship into continuation of the original route at an epistemic level.

changed_reading.after: Reaching the place opens a second convergence: the seeker must join a bearer of mercy and knowledge, and the endpoint becomes apprenticeship.
changed_reading.before: Reaching the meeting-place completes the announced search.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the recovered confluence, finding a mercy-given, taught servant converts place-arrival into a relational threshold. Moses must now follow another person in order to receive guidance, so convergence becomes an asymmetrical apprenticeship rather than the end of travel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence from recovered place to found servant to requested following; I infer that the confluence's functional goal is relational and epistemic. The live alternative is that the location is only a staging ground and does not itself model apprenticeship.
structural_cues: 18:65 begins with finding a servant immediately after the return to the sought site.
18:66 converts the encounter into a request to follow and be taught.

activation_trace.role: Continued persistence supplies the capacity that context will test and qualify.
Long duration supplies quantitative endurance, against which qualitative restraint is measured.
Holding the self back from reactive distress defines the newly required form of endurance.
Knowledge of an affair's interior names what immediate judgment lacks.
The demand not to ask makes speech-restraint the operational test of continued following.
Separation is the terminal consequence when the required restraint cannot be maintained.

changed_reading.after: Not ceasing proves insufficient by itself: continuation with the sought knowledge requires holding judgment through events whose reasons have not yet matured into view.
changed_reading.before: Not ceasing means being willing to keep traveling for a very long time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus vow promises duration and continued motion, but the encounter repeatedly tests whether the traveler can restrain judgment when he lacks the inside of an event. Questioning visible ruptures ends companionship, so endurance is recoded from mileage into patience under incomplete knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated patience language, absent interior knowledge, prohibited questioning, three objections, and separation; I infer that the focus vow's endurance is deliberately qualified as epistemic restraint. Alternatively, travel stamina and patience may remain adjacent but independent tests.
structural_cues: The patience prediction recurs after the breached ship and killed youth, then separation follows the wall episode.
The three objections arise before the reasons for the actions are supplied.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a limit provides the focus's explicit until-condition.
Extended duration keeps delayed completion within the focus's temporal horizon.
Return to an affair's eventual outcome shifts evaluation from first appearance to consequence.
Forcible seizure supplies the future threat that makes present damage protective.
One thing standing in place of another makes replacement, not the isolated loss, the relevant temporal unit.
The focus root recurs at the orphans' attainment of maturity, tying completion to a later threshold.
Arrival at full strength specifies the maturation that the preserved structure must await.
Bringing a hidden thing out completes the delayed protective sequence.

changed_reading.after: The long horizon also prepares a reader for outcomes that must ripen: what counts as reaching may be visible only when protection, replacement, or maturity completes a delayed sequence.
changed_reading.before: The long alternative in 18:60 measures how far Moses is prepared to continue before finding the site.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final explanations return disruptive acts to their later outcomes: damage blocks forcible seizure, loss is followed by replacement, and a wall preserves treasure until two orphans reach maturity and extract it. The focus's open-ended "until I reach" is thus activated as waiting for ends that become intelligible only on another timescale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit future reasons and the repeated reaching-until-maturity construction; I infer that the focus duration anticipates education in delayed ends. A live alternative is that the lexical recurrence coordinates timelines without revising the journey's meaning.
structural_cues: 18:78 announces explanation by outcome; 18:79-82 then pair each disturbing surface event with a later protective reason.
18:82 repeats the focus reaching-root inside an explicit until-maturity sequence.

remaining_uncertainties: The provision-to-waymark mechanism may describe only this singular sign rather than a general rule of guidance through loss.
The two epistemic seas model is a contained spatial analogy, not a forced reading of the dual.
The attendant-as-answer activation depends on a form-distant split root inventory and should remain wordplay-like rather than translational.
strongest_changes: Arrival is completed only after an already-reached site is recognized through overshoot, reversal, and traced return.
The confluence changes from geographic endpoint into an apprenticeship whose continuation depends on restraint before hidden reasons are disclosed.
The focus's long "until/reach" horizon is reactivated by 18:82, where preservation waits until maturity and extraction.
summary.what_was_special: A forgotten provision becomes a waymark, forward determination requires backward recovery, and the same reaching-root that names Moses's goal later names the maturation that delayed protection awaits.

activation_trace.role: Conjoining separated fields supplies the interface on which two ways of knowing can meet.
Depth allows one side of the analogy to exceed immediately visible surfaces.
Bewilderment names the reader's condition when surface appearance and eventual reason diverge.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the second field that later explanations open.
Knowing an affair's interior distinguishes disclosed rationale from visible event.
Eventual outcome reconnects the two fields after their apparent contradiction.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their meeting images the contact-zone between immediate appearance and an event's disclosed interior or outcome.
changed_reading.before: The two seas name only the physical coordinate Moses seeks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the physical dual into an epistemic analogy not forced by the grammar. It remains anchored in the focus's two seas, their depth and bewilderment branches, and the context's staged contrast between visible acts and disclosed outcomes. Render only as an exploratory spatial analogy, never as the lexical definition of the dual.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual "two seas" can carry two vast fields held together at one interface, while the sea inventory also permits depth and bewilderment.

activation_trace.role: The servant or attendant branch supplies the addressee's ordinary social function.
The split answer-giving inventory supplies an explicitly exploratory problem-resolving function.
Repetition of the attendant at the overshoot keeps him inside the failed recognition sequence.
The answer is delayed because the decisive event has dropped from active memory.
Recollection converts the attendant's report into the practical answer to the route problem.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the attendant also becomes the delayed answer-bearing mechanism through which the missed destination is identified.
changed_reading.before: The attendant is merely the companion to whom Moses announces his resolve.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the syntax plainly presents a youth or attendant, while the answer-giving branch belongs to the packet's split inventory for the same QAC root. It remains worth carrying because that attendant's recovered report answers where the sought site was. Render as a wordplay-like functional activation, not as a replacement translation of the noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressee "his youth/attendant" is the only human partner named in the focus vow, and the packet maps his root both to attendant and answer-giving inventories.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Reaching is framed as persistence toward a boundary.** `ب ل غ` B001 (“reaching the limit”) governs the meeting of seas, with prolonged travel as alternative cost. Dhul-Qarnayn later repeatedly reaches geographic limits by following supplied means (18:84–93), while the orphans must reach maturity before treasure emerges (18:82). I infer that an endpoint becomes accessible through sustained relation to a path, not desire alone. Moses’ resolve is necessary but will still require a missed sign and return.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Dhul-Qarnayn’s repeated reaching at 18:84–93 showed persistence succeeding through supplied means rather than resolve alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Open-ended time subordinated to a spatial sign.** `ح ق ب/B004` is a stretch of an age; `ح ق ب/B003` also images what is carried or stored behind. The preceding two ayat repeat appointed termini, while 18:61–64 makes the carried fish, forgotten behind at the junction, the trace that ends forward travel and triggers return. I infer that the heroic willingness to spend ages does not itself locate the goal; a neglected carried sign does. `حُقُبًا` reads as temporal persistence that must remain answerable to material markers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:61–64 supplied the correction: the journey’s age-long horizon is ended not by more forward persistence but by a forgotten carried sign and retracing.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a remembered speech scene while maintaining discourse continuity
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another item: fused with {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}), it launches a recalled speech scene while still bridging from the prior judgment summary. The ayah therefore turns from completed collective destruction into a named human journey without making the new scene feel detached.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: temporal recollection particle joined to the opener

topics.headline: resumptive bridge into recalled speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Mūsā scene is a fresh narrative block that remains connected to the prior discourse boundary.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence make {{ar:وَإِذْ}} ({{tr:wa-idh}}) the temporal speech-frame opener; the boundary rows coherently read the connector as both continuity and scene launch.

words.gloss_range: temporal recollection particle, with an implied recall frame and no local causal force
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) frames the scene as a remembered moment of speech, not as a causal argument. Its compact recollection frame can carry an implied summons to remember, while the quoted words inside it look forward: past narrator-time contains Mūsā's future-directed resolve.

topics.headline: remembered speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is entered through recollection of a speech event rather than through a free-standing historical date.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb and the formulaic ellipsis evidence support a recollection frame; local {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) blocks a causal-since reading as the controlling force.

topics.headline: past frame around future resolve
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal layering: the narrator recalls a completed saying whose content is still a projected quest.
topics.reason: The particle locates the speech in past recall, while the quote contains ongoing negation and subjunctive endpoints.

words.gloss_range: completed direct saying that introduces a performative vow
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) completes the speech act in narrator-time while opening quoted first-person resolve. Its simple Form I frame keeps Mūsā as the direct speaker, and the familiar Mūsā-speech pattern is narrowed here into a private vow addressed to his youth rather than a public confrontation. As the first content verb after the light opener, its hard qāf gives the frame a firm auditory landing before the vow begins.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, utterance, claim, and speech attribution; the local Form I verb selects direct utterance

topics.headline: completed direct vow speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote is a performed commitment, not a neutral report of information.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I verb introduces direct speech whose complement spans words 7-15; the following negated cessation clause makes the saying perform a vow.

topics.headline: private Mūsā speech pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a high-frequency prophetic speech frame is specialized into a private journey scene with the youth.
topics.reason: The q-w-l plus Mūsā and youth cooccurrence rows are coherent with the local prepositional addressee frame.

topics.headline: firm sound landing before the quote
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first content verb as a firm auditory landing before the vow opens.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but locally tied to the first lexical verb after two particles.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name functioning as the explicit subject and local seeker
words.prose: {{ar:مُوسَىٰ}} ({{tr:Mūsā}}) explicitly anchors the speaker before the later first-person verbs can drop the subject. The foreign proper name is not treated as an Arabic root-word here; its payoff is narrative and referential: the well-known prophet appears in a private seeker role, addressing his attached youth and moving from divine decree language into human resolve.

topics.headline: explicit speaker before pro-drop verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named subject secures every later first-person verb inside Mūsā's quoted agency.
topics.reason: The proper noun is the subject of {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), and the quote's first-person verbs are controlled by that speaker frame.

topics.headline: foreign name in seeker role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar named prophet is locally reweighted as a seeker without loading the name with an Arabic root derivation.
topics.reason: The non-Arabic proper-name evidence blocks root-based etymology, but the local narrative frame supports the seeker-role payoff.

topics.headline: private pairing with the youth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Mūsā's usual speech frame is narrowed to a companion scene rather than a public address.
topics.reason: The addressee phrase makes the Mūsā-speech pairing locally private and relational.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the recipient of speech
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) directs the saying to the youth and stops before the quoted vow begins. That small preposition makes the scene interpersonal: Mūsā is not merely speaking near his companion or about him, and the contrast with a topic-preposition in 18:83 sharpens this as face-to-face address.

topics.headline: directed speech recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vow is socially addressed to a companion, not simply narrated as inner resolve.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) as governing the genitive addressee after {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}).

topics.headline: addressee rather than topic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this speech-act orientation differs from a question-about frame such as 18:83.
topics.reason: The supplied contrast with 18:83 is valid as a prepositional speech-act contrast, while local syntax keeps {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) as addressee marking.

words.gloss_range: his youth, attendant, companion, or protege; locally the genitive addressee tied to Mūsā by suffix
words.prose: {{ar:فَتَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:fatāhu}}) is the governed addressee and the suffix makes the companion specific as Mūsā's. The word keeps youth, attendant, and protege senses open while a narrowed f-t-y derivational field lets learning and asking hover in the background; it does not turn the companion into a ruling-giver or replace the local social noun. Even where later tradition identifies him, the ayah itself leaves him relationally unnamed. Same-surah returns, especially 18:62, make the youth part of a speech-driven travel relation.
words.root_gloss_range: youth, service, formation, and disputed links to asking or ruling; local noun remains companion/addressee

topics.headline: possessed addressee companion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the youth is not generic; grammar defines him as Mūsā's addressed relational companion.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), and the suffix resolves to Mūsā by attachment evidence.

topics.headline: formative youth and asking field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the companion term carries formative youth and guidance-seeking pressure while local form keeps him a companion, not a legal term.
topics.reason: The root-family rows are useful, but the surface is a concrete noun, so legal asking or ruling derivatives can only color the background.

topics.headline: youth speech thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the youth is tied to recurring speech scenes in Surah 18, with the relation returning at 18:62.
topics.reason: The same-surah references support a local speech-companion pattern without forcing extra-Quranic identification into the text.

topics.headline: unnamed traditional identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that later tradition may identify the youth, while the ayah itself deliberately identifies him by relation to Mūsā.
topics.reason: The source row gives extra-Quranic identification, but the local Qur'anic wording leaves the companion unnamed.

topics.headline: paired journey after collective judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse scale change from anonymous communities to two named-or-related travelers.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the explicit Mūsā-plus-youth phrase.

words.gloss_range: indicative negation that turns cessation into persistence
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is not a prohibition; it negates Mūsā's own imperfect verb of ceasing. Because the negated verb is about stopping, the surface negative becomes positive persistence, and the clause remains open until {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) supplies its endpoint.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint particle that bounds the negated cessation clause

topics.headline: negated cessation as vow pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative wording actively states resolve: Mūsā will not stop until the goal is reached.
topics.reason: The particle negates an indicative first-person cessation verb, and the endpoint clause gives its scope.

words.gloss_range: I cease or leave, negated into I will not cease; local verb has an omitted predicate constrained by the endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:أَبْرَحُ}} ({{tr:abraḥu}}) carries the vow's main persistence claim. The initial hamza is Mūsā's first-person marker on the local cessation verb, not causative Form IV, and the missing predicate makes the continued state broader than one named activity. The b-r-ḥ field adds leaving, exposure, and hardship pressure, so the negated verb sounds like refusing to abandon the quest itself; the b-r-ḥ movement also gives the refusal a rough release. Rare echoes such as 12:85 and 20:91 make this an unyielding persistence formula.
words.root_gloss_range: leaving, ceasing, exposure, severity, and hardship; local use selects negated cessation with endurance pressure

topics.headline: Form I ellipsis of persistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb leaves the activity unstated, so the whole quest-state is what Mūsā refuses to stop.
topics.reason: The bundle's grammar identifies the verb as Form I despite a form-tag ambiguity; ellipsis evidence supports an omitted predicate constrained by the endpoint.

topics.headline: departure and hardship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that persistence is colored as refusing departure and enduring exposed difficulty, while cessation remains the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The broader b-r-ḥ family adds pressure, but local negation plus endpoint syntax selects non-cessation rather than a caused torment sense.

topics.headline: rare persistence echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Mūsā's phrase belongs to a small Quranic field of refusal-to-stop formulas, including 12:85.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence set supports a narrow echo field for unyielding continuance without overriding local syntax.

topics.headline: first-person chain and boundary reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first-person verb begins a repeated I-chain and reverses prior finality into human resolve.
topics.reason: The quote contains three first-person verbs controlled by Mūsā, and the boundary rows coherently read this as a shift from completed decree to prospective resolve.

topics.headline: rough release of refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a rough sound texture on the verb that carries the refusal to quit.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is locally tied to the vow's central verb.

words.gloss_range: terminative and purposive particle governing the subjunctive goal
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) turns the refusal to stop toward a goal. Here it selects the terminative-purpose value, governing {{ar:أَبْلُغَ}} ({{tr:ablugha}}) as unrealized reaching rather than meaning inclusive even, and its geminated tā gives the limit a tightened sound at the pivot. It anticipates the next ayah's arrival wording in 18:61.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjunctive reaching verb governed by the endpoint particle

topics.headline: subjunctive goal limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Mūsā's persistence is not aimless; the particle binds it to a future endpoint and purpose.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence identify {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) as introducing the purpose or temporal endpoint clause.

topics.headline: goal answered in 18:61
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint particle sets up the lexical answer narrated in 18:61.
topics.reason: The supplied boundary row connects this endpoint with the following ayah's arrival.

topics.headline: tight limit sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tightened sound of the limit particle at the pivot into the goal.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally tied to the geminated particle that marks the limit.

words.gloss_range: I reach or attain, locally subjunctive under the endpoint particle with a direct object
words.prose: {{ar:أَبْلُغَ}} ({{tr:ablugha}}) is the unrealized reaching verb governed by {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}). The first-person Form I keeps Mūsā as the attainer rather than a causative deliverer, while the b-l-gh field makes the destination a threshold of adequate arrival. The same root is immediately answered in 18:61 and later helps frame limits and thresholds in the surah, including 18:76. Against 18:59's appointed point, this word shifts the boundary into Mūsā actively seeking arrival.
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, attaining, delivery, sufficiency, maturity, and eloquence; local use selects self-attainment of a destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint particle governing the reaching verb

topics.headline: subjunctive self-attainment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the goal is projected as Mūsā's own future reaching, not as an achieved fact or caused delivery.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}), has Mūsā as first-person subject, and takes {{ar:مَجْمَعَ}} ({{tr:majmaʿa}}) as direct object.

topics.headline: threshold and sufficiency pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reaching feels like threshold-attainment, while eloquence and maturity senses remain background range rather than the local translation.
topics.reason: The b-l-gh semantic family is broad, but the local object selects reaching a place.

topics.headline: surah reaching thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the intended reaching in 18:60 becomes narrated arrival in 18:61 and later boundary language in 18:76.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah references support a b-l-gh threshold thread without changing the local destination sense.

topics.headline: appointed point to human reaching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from a divinely appointed point in 18:59 to Mūsā actively seeking an arrival point in 18:60.
topics.reason: The boundary rows coherently connect appointed fulfillment with the human reaching verb.

words.gloss_range: meeting-place or confluence, locally the direct object reached and construct head of the two seas
words.prose: {{ar:مَجْمَعَ}} ({{tr:majmaʿa}}) is the object Mūsā seeks to reach, not just scenery. Its mīm-pattern turns gathering into a place, and its construct state waits for {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥrayni}}) to specify the confluence. The variant vocalization keeps attention on the form, while 18:61 repeats the destination and 55:19-20 supplies a contrast: here the two-sea meeting is a humanly sought location, not a cosmic releasing scene. After 18:59's appointed point, the gathering root makes the next boundary a pursued place where lines converge.
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, assembly, consensus, and convergence; local form makes a place of convergence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite dual genitive specifying the meeting-place

topics.headline: reached construct confluence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is a specific relational confluence defined by the two seas.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مَجْمَعَ}} ({{tr:majmaʿa}}) the direct object of reaching and the construct head before the genitive dual.

topics.headline: place-form gathering pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad gathering root is concentrated into a location of convergence, with time or consensus senses only resonant.
topics.reason: The noun-time/place form and reaching verb select place locally, while broader j-m-ʿ senses remain controlled background.

topics.headline: confluence echo and contrast
